snippet.title: Loaded Dice - Teaser
snippet.description:
Try Loaded Dice on Steam Now !

 Loaded Dice is a Yatzy roguelike where you have to build your deck through special dice and charms. 

Explode your multipliers, win rounds and go deeper in the Casino to discover what is going on there !
